# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan’s Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)</sub>

## Appearance

Obed is an unusual-appearing, quiet man with an awkward frame. He has lengthy iron-gray hair reaching his hunching shoulders and a thick, gentle brown beard that he has worn continuously since the age of twenty.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Obed is an extremely timid, quiet, and taciturn individual who despises being surrounded by unfamiliar people or having to converse. He is particularly bashful around women, fearing they might be quietly mocking him. Despite his shy and silent demeanor, he appreciates loquacious companions who handle conversation on their own, and he possesses a quiet, persistent stubbornness when he fixes his heart on something.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P27](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0027), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c10 P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013)_

- Farming and turnip planting  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005)</sub>
- Driving a buggy  <sub>[v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c2 P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000)</sub>

## Goals

- To secure hired or adopted help to assist him with farm chores due to advancing age and heart trouble  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)</sub>
- To keep and care for Nell at Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c3 P55](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0055), [v1 c3 P61](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0061), [v1 c6 P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 c6 P32](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0032)</sub>

## History

Obed Abernethy grew up at Grey Shutters, a farmstead set far back from the main thoroughfare in Brierley. Due to advancing age and heart trouble, he and his sister Thirza arranged through Mrs. Alexander Tranter to adopt an orphan boy from Nova Scotia to assist with farm work. However, when Obed drove the sorrel mare to Alder River station to meet the train, he found that a young girl, Nell Harcourt, had been sent by mistake instead. Though bewildered and timid, Obed drove Nell back to Grey Shutters, enjoying her loquacious chatter along the way. Upon arriving, Thirza initially insisted on returning Nell to the asylum, but Obed developed a fondness for the girl and quietly advocated for keeping her. Despite Thirza taking her to Pale Sands to arrange her return or reassignment, Obed hired a local French boy for farm labor in hopes of keeping Nell. His quiet determination eventually persuaded Thirza to let Nell stay. When Nell was later confined to her room for refusing to apologize to Agatha Sowerby, Obed secretly tiptoed upstairs to comfort her and gently persuaded her to apologize. He later bought chocolate sweeties for Nell in Delford, delighting her and cementing their warm bond.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000), [v1 c2 P6](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0006), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c3 P55](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0055), [v1 c3 P61](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0061), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c4 P43](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0043), [v1 c6 P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 c6 P32](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0032), [v1 c10 P6](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0006), [v1 c10 P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013), [v1 c12 P42](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0042)_

## Background by volume

- His father built the farmstead at Grey Shutters far back from the main thoroughfare to distance himself from other people  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Suffers from significant heart trouble  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>
- He and his sister Thirza reached adulthood by the time the house at Grey Shutters was built  <sub>[v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
- Rarely smokes tobacco except when his mind is deeply troubled  <sub>[v1 c3 P51](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0051)</sub>

## Quotes

> Well now, I don’t know.  <sub>[v1 c2 P23](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0023)</sub>

> A girl is not what I’m expecting. A boy is who I’ve come for. Here is where he should be. For me, Mrs. Alexander Tranter was supposed to bring him over from Nova Scotia.  <sub>[v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007)</sub>

> Oh, you are free to speak as long as you wish. It does not bother me.  <sub>[v1 c2 P28](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0028)</sub>

> Well now, Nell, wouldn’t it be best if you just got it finished and behind you?  <sub>[v1 c10 P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013)</sub>
